questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some A are T.

II. Some T are H.

**Conclusions:**

I. No T is A.

II. No H is T.

III. No A is H.

options.text: Only conclusion I follows
All conclusion follows
Only conclusion II follows
Neither conclusion follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given below according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a26a379e565cd9f833b274373ebfffdd48b672d148f5b2a6a257233ece819df.png] 

Conclusion:

I. No T is A → **Does not follow **→ (As some A are T and some T are H. So, no T is A is not definitely followed)

II. No H is T → **Does not follow **→ (As some A are T and some T are H. So, no H is T is not definitely followed)

III. No A is H → **Does not follow **→ (As some A are T and some T are H. So no A is H is not definitely followed)

So, Neither conclusion follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.solution:

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements: **

All reds are roses. 

No violet is red. 

Some tulips are violets. 

**Conclusions: **

I. Some roses are violets. 

II. No tulip is a red. 

III. No rose is a tulip.

options.text: Only conclusion II follows.
Both conclusions I and III follow.
None of the conclusion follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83fbcad9d56921203ad2af0b6e072a23572fbf1c3f7ead48095a949ca7395847.png] 

Conclusions: 

I. Some roses are violets. → False (There is no relation between roses and violets, therefore conclusion I is incorrect.)

II. No tulip is a red.→False (Tulips and red also has no relation, therefore conclusion II is also incorrect.)

III. No rose is a tulip. → False (As there is no definite negative relation given between them, definite negative conclusion will also be false.)

None of the conclusion follows here.

Hence, the correct answer is **"None of the conclusion follows".**

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements :**

Some bells are pumps.

All pumps are skates.

All bells are kites.

**Conclusions :**

1. Some kites are skates.

2. Some skates are bells.

3. Some skates are pumps.

options.text: Both conclusions 1 and 3 follow.
Both conclusions 2 and 3 follow.
All conclusions1, 2 and 3 follow.
Both conclusions 1 and 2 follow.

questions.solution:
Given:

Statements :

Some bells are pumps.

All pumps are skates.

All bells are kites.

The least possible Venn Diagram is given as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ccd2f5f8af48eb032ea6b9c3265c2259f694d0a407aa3052f8bc41c9e205ed0.png] 

Conclusions :

1. Some kites are skates. → **Follows. **(Some bells are pumps. All pumps are skates. All bells are kites. So, some kites are definitely skates.)

2. Some skates are bells. → **Follows. **(Some bells are pumps. All pumps are skates. All bells are kites. So, some skates are definitely bells.)

3. Some skates are pumps. → **Follows. **(All pumps are skates and so, some skates are definitely pumps.)

Therefore, all the conclusions follow. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
